gloss: whichever is fine; any one will do

definitions.gloss: whichever is fine; any one will do; it doesn't matter which
definitions.explanation: Used to express indifference about a choice, indicating that any option among a set is acceptable. Can convey flexibility, indecision, or lack of preference.

examples.japanese: どれでもいい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

examples.english: "Which color do you want?" "Any one is fine."

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どれでもいい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Any drink is fine, so please give me the cheapest one.

notes:
Composed of ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ (which one) + ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧ (even, any) + ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good, fine). A fundamental conversational expression for expressing no preference. The tone can range from easygoing flexibility to slight frustration depending on context and intonation.

RELATED PATTERNS:

- ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: anything is fine
- ⟦いつでもいい→いつでもいい：17660_itsudemoii⟧: anytime is fine
- ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: anyone is fine

USAGE:
While this expression is useful and common, be aware that responding with どれでもいい when someone asks for your preference can sometimes sound dismissive or uninterested. In polite situations, it is better to name a preference or add a softener.
